para.text: ). The reason for this is that XYGRAPH does not make a copy of these arrays but simply stores its address (pointer). If the array is for example declared locally within a procedure the data gets lost once you exit this procedure. Any further attempt to access the data, for example when applying data tracking or using the 3D ruler causes an error because the array pointer that is stored now points to something random.
